What We Do

Clear questions.
Useful outcomes.

From strategy through execution, depending on what the project needs.

01

Entering Indonesia or Japan?

Market context, research and cultural understanding.

Example outputs

Market scans, audience insight, opportunity assessments and localization recommendations.

02

Looking for the right partners?

Relevant companies, creators, institutions and communities.

Example outputs

Partner landscapes, shortlists, introductions and facilitated business meetings.

03

Developing an idea or IP?

Positioning, storytelling and creative development.

04

Core services

Research & Insight / Strategy & Advisory / Partnerships & Connections / Creative & IP Development / Execution & Delivery

Engagement starting points

Start focused.
Build from there.

Projects can begin with a focused research or advisory scope and scale into broader strategy, partnerships, creative development or execution.

Focused research sprint

A defined business question, a clear evidence base and useful recommendations.

Strategy or advisory

Local context and an outside perspective before your next decision.

Partner search & introductions

Find the companies, creators or institutions that fit the opportunity.

Creative or activation development

Develop an early idea into a relevant concept, campaign or experience.

End-to-end delivery

Connect strategy, partners, production and execution in one project.

Ongoing advisory

Continued market insight, connections and decision support as needs evolve.

What a project can look like

Japan Wave Expo

Example based on Rinintha Pradiza’s prior experience, not a dot.wave commission.

A Japanese organization wants to build awareness and business opportunities in Indonesia.

  1. Understand the market and objective.
  2. Connect with buyers, media and partners.
  3. Create a relevant public-facing experience.
  4. Deliver the B2B and B2C program on the ground.
